examples.text: Nirgendwo in der Welt ist die Selbstheirat erlaubt, auch aus steuerlichen Gründen nicht.
examples.translation: Marrying oneself is not allowed anywhere in the world - not even for tax reasons.
examples.english: Marrying oneself is not allowed anywhere in the world - not even for tax reasons.

examples.text: Nach derartigen Selbstbestätigungsversuchen folgen Eigenliebe, Selbstheirat und Funktionieren als Gebärmaschine von kleinen Monstern.
examples.translation: From these kinds of attempts at self-affirmation come self-love, self-marriage, and the role of birthing-machine for little monsters.
examples.english: From these kinds of attempts at self-affirmation come self-love, self-marriage, and the role of birthing-machine for little monsters.

examples.text: Finde ich keinen Liebhaber, der sich nicht vor meinem Buckel ekelt, ist eine Selbstheirat nicht auszuschliessen. Ich liebe mich.
examples.translation: Should I find no lover who is not disgusted by my hunchback, then a marriage to myself is not out of the question. I love myself.
examples.english: Should I find no lover who is not disgusted by my hunchback, then a marriage to myself is not out of the question. I love myself.

examples.text: Er hatte natürlich Recht. Wenngleich man aus seinen Worten klar heraushören konnte, dass er diese Selbstheirat nur als Vorstufe zu einer christlichen Ehe zwischen Mann und Frau sah.
examples.translation: He was right, of course. Even though you could clearly hear from his words that he saw marriage to oneself only as a step towards a Christian marriage between husband and wife.
examples.english: He was right, of course. Even though you could clearly hear from his words that he saw marriage to oneself only as a step towards a Christian marriage between husband and wife.

glosses: Marriage within one's family or social group.

examples.text: Weil aber Nachkommen gezeugt werden müssen und andere Allianzpartner ausfallen, kommt es zur orientalischen Selbstheirat. "Brüder" müssen sich im technischen Sinne der "Schwestern" annehmen, so wie das für Gott geopferte Tier letztlich in rein technischen Sinne von den Opfernden selbst und nicht vom Adressaten verspeist wird.
examples.translation: However, because descendants still need to be produced, and other allies fail, it all rests on eastern "self-marriage". "Brothers" must, in a technical sense, take on "sisters", just like how animals sacrificed to God are, in a purely technical sense, eaten by the offerers and not by the addressees.
examples.english: However, because descendants still need to be produced, and other allies fail, it all rests on eastern "self-marriage". "Brothers" must, in a technical sense, take on "sisters", just like how animals sacrificed to God are, in a purely technical sense, eaten by the offerers and not by the addressees.

examples.text: Im Gegensatz zur Heirat, so argumentiert Pfeffer, findet beim gotr der Tausch der Seelen innerhalb des gleichen Klans statt, ist also eine metaphysische Selbstheirat.
examples.translation: In contrast to marriage, Pfeffer argues, during gotr an exchange of souls takes place among the same clan, and it is therefore a metaphysical self-marriage.
examples.english: In contrast to marriage, Pfeffer argues, during gotr an exchange of souls takes place among the same clan, and it is therefore a metaphysical self-marriage.

examples.text: Beim afghanischen Stamm der Ghilzai wird dies heute noch als „Selbstheirat“ bezeichnet und entspricht dem Brauch, dass die Kinder zweier Brüder heiraten (patrilaterale Parallelcousin und -cousine).
examples.translation: For the Afghan tribe from Ghilzai, this practice is today known as "self-marriage", and corresponds to the custom of children marrying two brothers (patrilineal parallel cousins).
examples.english: For the Afghan tribe from Ghilzai, this practice is today known as "self-marriage", and corresponds to the custom of children marrying two brothers (patrilineal parallel cousins).
